# Unbuilt — Full Documentation for AI

> The home base for the vibecoding generation.
> URL: https://www.unbuilt.me

## What is Unbuilt?

Unbuilt is a market intelligence platform purpose-built for the vibecoding generation. It combines three tools — Pulse, Dig, and Stack — to help vibe coders, indie hackers, and no-code founders discover what to build, validate whether it's worth building, and find the fastest path to ship.

## Product Details

### Launches (Free)
- Daily feed of every new app launched on App Store and Product Hunt, scanned once per day
- Each app gets AI analysis: what it does, difficulty level (simple/medium/hard), competitors, and exact tools to build it
- Links to "Dig my idea" for full market analysis or "Get my Stack" for build plan
- No account required — completely free
- Use case: "I want to find my next project idea by seeing what's being built and where the gaps are"

### Dig (Market Analysis)
- Accepts any app idea described in plain language
- Scans 70+ live data sources including App Store, Google Play, Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, Product Hunt, LinkedIn, and more
- Returns: competitor list with ratings, user pain points, market gaps, SWOT analysis, go-to-market strategy suggestions, and a market opportunity score (0-100)
- Processing time: approximately 5 minutes
- Cost: 1 credit per report
- Use case: "I have an idea for a freelancer invoicing app — is it worth building?"

### Stack (Build Plan)
- Accepts your app idea, budget tier (bootstrap / growing / funded / scale), and technical level (no-code / low-code / developer)
- Recommends tools from a database of 700+ developer and no-code tools with current 2026 pricing
- Returns a phased build plan: Phase 0 (validate), Phase 1 (launch), Phase 2 (scale)
- Includes cost breakdowns and setup instructions for each recommended tool
- Cost: 1 credit per report
- Use case: "I want to build a SaaS — what tools should I use given my $50/month budget and no-code skills?"

## Ideas Directory

Unbuilt hosts 2,400+ pre-analyzed app idea pages at unbuilt.me/ideas. Each page is independently accessible and includes:
- Opportunity Score (0-100): reflects market saturation, demand signals, and gap size
- Estimated competitor count
- Market overview (4-6 sentences of analysis)
- Key insight (one actionable takeaway)
- Related ideas for further exploration
- Direct link to run a full Dig report

### Idea Categories
- SaaS (micro-SaaS, boilerplates, billing, onboarding, churn prediction)
- AI Tools (image generators, writing assistants, chatbot builders, voice/video generators)
- Developer Tools (API testing, database GUIs, CI/CD, monitoring, deployment)
- Productivity (habit trackers, todo apps, note-taking, time blocking, focus timers)
- Finance (budget trackers, expense splitters, crypto portfolios, tax prep, FIRE calculators)
- Health (workout trackers, meal planners, meditation, sleep tracking, mental health)
- Education (flashcards, language learning, spaced repetition, coding practice)
- E-commerce (dropshipping, inventory, abandoned cart recovery, product research)
- Marketing (email marketing, landing pages, A/B testing, social proof, UTM builders)
- Content Creation (blog tools, social schedulers, podcast hosting, SEO assistants)
- Freelancing (invoicing, contract management, time tracking, client portals, rate calculators)
- Community (forum builders, Discord bots, membership sites, feedback boards)
- Design (UI tools, prototyping, icon makers, animation, brand kit builders)
- Automation (workflow automation, Zapier alternatives, no-code automation, chatbot builders)
- Analytics (web analytics, product analytics, session recording, rank tracking)
- HR & Hiring (ATS, resume builders, job boards, performance reviews, payroll)
- Travel (trip planners, flight trackers, digital nomad tools, visa checkers)
- Real Estate (property management, tenant screening, mortgage calculators)
- Food & Restaurant (POS systems, menu builders, food delivery, recipe management)
- Legal (contract generators, NDA generators, privacy policy generators, compliance)
- Pet (health trackers, walking apps, sitting marketplaces, grooming schedulers)
- Parenting (milestone trackers, family calendars, chore charts, screen time managers)
- Sustainability (carbon footprint trackers, energy monitors, recycling guides)

### Idea URL Patterns
- Best X for Y: unbuilt.me/ideas/best-[tool]-for-[audience]
- Alternatives: unbuilt.me/ideas/[tool]-alternative
- How to build: unbuilt.me/ideas/how-to-build-a-[tool]
- Top tools: unbuilt.me/ideas/top-[tool]-tools-2026
- Market gaps: unbuilt.me/ideas/[tool]-market-gap
- Comparisons: unbuilt.me/ideas/[tool-a]-vs-[tool-b]

## Competitive Positioning

Unbuilt is the only tool that covers the full vibe coder journey: discover → validate → build. Comparable tools cover only one step:
- Product Hunt covers discovery but not analysis
- SimilarWeb provides data but not for vibe coders specifically
- ChatGPT can analyze anything but nothing specifically or with real-time market data
- Ahrefs/SEMrush focus on SEO, not app idea validation

## Pricing
- Pulse: Free, no account required
- Dig: 1 credit per report
- Stack: 1 credit per report
- Credits can be purchased on the pricing page: https://www.unbuilt.me/pricing
